requirements.quote:
The keys found in certificates MUST also
   be of appropriate type for the signature algorithms they are used
   with.
requirements.condition: a certificate key is used with a signature algorithm
requirements.required_behavior: ensure that the certificate key type is appropriate for that signature algorithm
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use an incompatible certificate key type
requirements.why_checkable: Certificate key metadata and selected signature scheme can be compared before signing or verification.

requirements.quote:
If no "signature_algorithms_cert" extension is
   present, then the "signature_algorithms" extension also applies to
   signatures appearing in certificates.
requirements.condition: signature_algorithms_cert is absent
requirements.required_behavior: apply the signature_algorithms extension to certificate signatures as well as CertificateVerify signatures
requirements.forbidden_behavior: ignore signature_algorithms when selecting or validating certificate signatures
requirements.why_checkable: Certificate signature acceptance can be varied while omitting signature_algorithms_cert.

requirements.quote:
Clients which desire the
   server to authenticate itself via a certificate MUST send the
   "signature_algorithms" extension.
requirements.condition: a client requests server authentication by certificate
requirements.required_behavior: send the signature_algorithms extension
requirements.why_checkable: The client's authentication configuration and emitted ClientHello are inspectable.

requirements.quote:
If a server is authenticating via
   a certificate and the client has not sent a "signature_algorithms"
   extension, then the server MUST abort the handshake with a
   "missing_extension" alert (see Section 9.2).
requirements.condition: a server authenticates by certificate and the client omitted signature_algorithms
requirements.error_behavior: abort the handshake with a missing_extension alert
requirements.why_checkable: A ClientHello can omit the extension and the server's alert can be asserted.

requirements.quote: TLS 1.2 implementations SHOULD also process this extension.
requirements.condition: a TLS 1.2 implementation receives signature_algorithms_cert
requirements.required_behavior: process the signature_algorithms_cert extension
requirements.why_checkable: A TLS 1.2 handshake can carry the extension and exercise its certificate-policy effect.

requirements.quote:
The "extension_data" field of these extensions contains a
   SignatureSchemeList value:
requirements.condition: when encoding or parsing signature_algorithms or signature_algorithms_cert
requirements.required_behavior: encode extension_data as a SignatureSchemeList
requirements.why_checkable: The extension parser can assert the declared message structure.

requirements.required_behavior: map rsa_pkcs1_sha256 to SignatureScheme code point 0x0401
requirements.why_checkable: The enum name-to-wire-value mapping is exact.

requirements.quote: private_use(0xFE00..0xFFFF),
requirements.condition: when encoding or decoding a private-use SignatureScheme
requirements.required_behavior: recognize 0xFE00 through 0xFFFF as the private_use range
requirements.why_checkable: The enum range boundaries are exact wire-level constants.

requirements.quote: SignatureScheme supported_signature_algorithms<2..2^16-2>;
requirements.condition: when encoding or parsing a SignatureSchemeList
requirements.required_behavior: encode supported_signature_algorithms as a SignatureScheme vector with content length between 2 and 65534 bytes
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode an empty vector or a vector outside the 2-to-65534-byte range
requirements.why_checkable: The vector length prefix and element parsing expose the declared bounds.

requirements.quote:
Each SignatureScheme value lists a single signature algorithm that
   the client is willing to verify.
requirements.condition: when a client includes a SignatureScheme value
requirements.required_behavior: treat the value as identifying one signature algorithm the client is willing to verify
requirements.forbidden_behavior: interpret one value as advertising multiple signature algorithms
requirements.why_checkable: The enum-to-algorithm dispatch table can be inspected and exercised.

requirements.quote:
The values are indicated in
   descending order of preference.
requirements.condition: when constructing a SignatureSchemeList
requirements.required_behavior: list signature schemes in descending order of client preference
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized order can be compared with configured preferences.

requirements.quote:
RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 algorithms:  Indicates a signature algorithm using
      RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 [RFC8017] with the corresponding hash algorithm
      as defined in [SHS].
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 SignatureScheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: use the RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 signature algorithm
requirements.forbidden_behavior: dispatch to another RSA signature algorithm
requirements.why_checkable: The selected SignatureScheme and cryptographic signing or verification primitive can be compared.

requirements.quote:
RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 algorithms:  Indicates a signature algorithm using
      RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 [RFC8017] with the corresponding hash algorithm
      as defined in [SHS].
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 SignatureScheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: use the hash algorithm corresponding to the selected scheme
requirements.why_checkable: The scheme name fixes the hash and can be compared with cryptographic parameters.

requirements.quote:
These values refer solely to signatures
      which appear in certificates
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 SignatureScheme value is used
requirements.required_behavior: limit its use to signatures appearing in certificates
requirements.why_checkable: Signature-scheme selection can distinguish certificate signatures from handshake signatures.

requirements.quote:
and are not
      defined for use in signed TLS handshake messages
requirements.condition: a signed TLS handshake message is generated or verified
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use an RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 SignatureScheme for the handshake signature
requirements.why_checkable: CertificateVerify scheme acceptance and generation are directly testable.

requirements.quote:
ECDSA algorithms:  Indicates a signature algorithm using ECDSA
      [ECDSA], the corresponding curve as defined in ANSI X9.62 [ECDSA]
      and FIPS 186-4 [DSS], and the corresponding hash algorithm as
      defined in [SHS].
requirements.condition: an ECDSA SignatureScheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: use ECDSA with the curve corresponding to the selected scheme
requirements.why_checkable: The selected scheme fixes the ECDSA curve used by signing and verification.

requirements.quote:
ECDSA algorithms:  Indicates a signature algorithm using ECDSA
      [ECDSA], the corresponding curve as defined in ANSI X9.62 [ECDSA]
      and FIPS 186-4 [DSS], and the corresponding hash algorithm as
      defined in [SHS].
requirements.condition: an ECDSA SignatureScheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: use the hash algorithm corresponding to the selected scheme
requirements.why_checkable: The selected scheme fixes the hash used by ECDSA signing and verification.

requirements.quote:
The signature is represented as a DER-encoded
      [X690] ECDSA-Sig-Value structure.
requirements.condition: an ECDSA signature scheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: represent the signature as a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value structure
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a non-DER or non-ECDSA-Sig-Value representation
requirements.why_checkable: Signature bytes can be parsed for DER canonical structure.

requirements.quote:
RSASSA-PSS RSAE algorithms:  Indicates a signature algorithm using
      RSASSA-PSS [RFC8017] with mask generation function 1.
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS RSAE signature scheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: use RSASSA-PSS with mask generation function 1
requirements.why_checkable: RSA-PSS algorithm parameters can be inspected during signing and verification.

requirements.quote:
The digest
      used in the mask generation function and the digest being signed
      are both the corresponding hash algorithm as defined in [SHS].
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS RSAE signature scheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: use the scheme's corresponding hash algorithm for the mask generation function digest
requirements.why_checkable: The configured MGF1 digest can be compared with the selected scheme.

requirements.quote:
The digest
      used in the mask generation function and the digest being signed
      are both the corresponding hash algorithm as defined in [SHS].
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS RSAE signature scheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: use the scheme's corresponding hash algorithm as the digest being signed
requirements.forbidden_behavior: sign a digest produced by a different hash algorithm
requirements.why_checkable: The signing digest selection can be compared with the selected scheme.

requirements.quote:
The length of the Salt MUST be equal to the length of the output
      of the digest algorithm.
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS RSAE signature is generated or verified
requirements.required_behavior: set the salt length equal to the digest output length
requirements.why_checkable: RSA-PSS parameters expose both the digest and salt lengths.

requirements.quote:
If the public key is carried in an X.509
      certificate, it MUST use the rsaEncryption OID [RFC5280].
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS RSAE public key is carried in an X.509 certificate
requirements.required_behavior: identify the public key with the rsaEncryption OID
requirements.forbidden_behavior: identify it with another public-key OID
requirements.why_checkable: The SubjectPublicKeyInfo algorithm OID is directly available in the certificate.

requirements.quote:
Note that these
      correspond to the "PureEdDSA" algorithms and not the "prehash"
      variants.
requirements.condition: an EdDSA SignatureScheme defined here is used
requirements.required_behavior: use the PureEdDSA algorithm variant
requirements.why_checkable: The signing and verification algorithm variant is a concrete cryptographic dispatch choice.

requirements.quote:
RSASSA-PSS PSS algorithms:  Indicates a signature algorithm using
      RSASSA-PSS [RFC8017] with mask generation function 1.
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS PSS signature scheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: use RSASSA-PSS with mask generation function 1
requirements.why_checkable: RSA-PSS algorithm parameters can be inspected during signing and verification.

requirements.quote:
The digest
      used in the mask generation function and the digest being signed
      are both the corresponding hash algorithm as defined in [SHS].
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS PSS signature scheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: use the scheme's corresponding hash algorithm for the mask generation function digest
requirements.why_checkable: The configured MGF1 digest can be compared with the selected scheme.

requirements.quote:
The digest
      used in the mask generation function and the digest being signed
      are both the corresponding hash algorithm as defined in [SHS].
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS PSS signature scheme is used
requirements.required_behavior: use the scheme's corresponding hash algorithm as the digest being signed
requirements.forbidden_behavior: sign a digest produced by a different hash algorithm
requirements.why_checkable: The signing digest selection can be compared with the selected scheme.

requirements.quote:
The length of the Salt MUST be equal to the length of the digest
      algorithm.
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS PSS signature is generated or verified
requirements.required_behavior: set the salt length equal to the digest output length
requirements.why_checkable: RSA-PSS parameters expose both the digest and salt lengths.

requirements.quote:
If the public key is carried in an X.509 certificate,
      it MUST use the RSASSA-PSS OID [RFC5756].
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS PSS public key is carried in an X.509 certificate
requirements.required_behavior: identify the public key with the RSASSA-PSS OID
requirements.forbidden_behavior: identify it with another public-key OID
requirements.why_checkable: The SubjectPublicKeyInfo algorithm OID is directly available in the certificate.

requirements.quote:
When used in
      certificate signatures, the algorithm parameters MUST be DER
      encoded.
requirements.condition: an RSASSA-PSS PSS scheme is used in a certificate signature
requirements.required_behavior: DER-encode the algorithm parameters
requirements.why_checkable: Certificate AlgorithmIdentifier parameter bytes can be parsed for DER encoding.

requirements.quote:
If the corresponding public key's parameters are
      present, then the parameters in the signature MUST be identical to
      those in the public key.
requirements.condition: the corresponding RSASSA-PSS public key contains parameters
requirements.required_behavior: make the signature algorithm parameters identical to the public-key parameters
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use differing signature and public-key parameters
requirements.why_checkable: The two DER parameter structures can be decoded and compared for equality.
